# semver

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-bots/internal/semver"
```

Package semver is the release\-version arithmetic of the BlanketOps family: tags are vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, and the bump a release needs comes from the Conventional Commits it contains.

<a name="Bump"></a>
## type Bump

Bump is the size of a version step.

```go
type Bump int
```

<a name="Patch"></a>Bumps from smallest to largest.

```go
const (
    Patch Bump = iota
    Minor
    Major
)
```

<a name="Required"></a>
### func Required

```go
func Required(prev Version, commits []Commit) Bump
```

Required returns the smallest bump from prev that the commits allow. From 1.0.0 on: a breaking change needs major, a feat needs minor, anything else patch. Before 1.0.0 the public API is not yet stable, so a breaking change needs minor and everything else patch.

<a name="Commit"></a>
## type Commit

Commit is one commit message, classified as a Conventional Commit.

```go
type Commit struct {
    SHA     string
    Subject string
    // Type is the Conventional Commits type ("feat", "fix", ...); empty
    // when the subject does not follow the convention.
    Type     string
    Scope    string
    Breaking bool
    // Merge marks a merge commit, which carries no change of its own.
    Merge bool
}
```

<a name="ParseCommit"></a>
### func ParseCommit

```go
func ParseCommit(sha, msg string) Commit
```

ParseCommit classifies the full commit message msg.

<a name="Commit.Conventional"></a>
### func \(Commit\) Conventional

```go
func (c Commit) Conventional() bool
```

Conventional reports whether the subject follows Conventional Commits. Merge commits count as conventional: they add no change of their own.

<a name="Version"></a>
## type Version

Version is a release version vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.

```go
type Version struct{ Major, Minor, Patch int }
```

<a name="Latest"></a>
### func Latest

```go
func Latest(tags []string) (Version, bool)
```

Latest returns the highest release version among tags; tags that are not release versions are ignored. ok is false when there is none.

<a name="Parse"></a>
### func Parse

```go
func Parse(s string) (Version, error)
```

Parse reads "vX.Y.Z". Pre\-release and build suffixes are not release versions here and are rejected.

<a name="Version.Compare"></a>
### func \(Version\) Compare

```go
func (v Version) Compare(w Version) int
```

Compare returns \-1, 0 or 1 as v is lower than, equal to or higher than w.

<a name="Version.Next"></a>
### func \(Version\) Next

```go
func (v Version) Next(b Bump) Version
```

Next returns v bumped by b.

<a name="Version.StepFrom"></a>
### func \(Version\) StepFrom

```go
func (v Version) StepFrom(prev Version) (Bump, bool)
```

StepFrom reports which single bump takes prev to v. ok is false when v is not one of prev's three successors \(lower, equal, or a skipped number\).
